366718537734.title: 1704 Philip Cluver Antique Map Persia Armenia Assyria Mesopotamia Hand Colored
366718537734.desc: 1704 PHILIP CLUVER ANTIQUE MAP — PERSIA, ARMENIA, ASSYRIA, MESOPOTAMIA & BABYLONIA Offered is an ORIGINAL antique hand-colored map by the famous early geographer Philip Cluver, depicting Persia and surrounding regions of the Middle East and Central Asia. The map is titled: "PERSIA SIVE SOPHORUM REGNUM CUM ARMENIA ASSYRIA MESOPOTAMIA ET BABYLONIA" The map covers the historic Persian Empire and surrounding regions, including Persia, Armenia, Assyria, Mesopotamia, Babylonia, parts of Arabia, the Caucasus, the Caspian Sea and surrounding areas. The map features exceptionally detailed copperplate engraving, numerous historical place names, mountain ranges, rivers, lakes, seas and other geographic features, along with an attractive decorative cartouche. IMPORTANT HISTORICAL PROVENANCE: This exact map was purchased by me on eBay in 2010. I have retained the original printed eBay listing from the previous owner/seller, which identified the map as a genuine 1704 Philip Cluver antique map. The original listing sold in February 2010 for $45 after six bids. The original seller described the map as an original engraved, hand-colored antique map and stated that it was approximately 10" x 8". Please note that the original seller's description is included as historical provenance; the exact edition/date of this particular impression has not been independently certified by me. CONDITION: Please examine all photographs carefully. This is an approximately 300+ year-old antique map and has significant age and handling wear. The map retains its beautiful original hand coloring and extremely detailed engraved image, but it has multiple folds, age toning, staining, edge wear and several tears/splits along the margins and edges. The reverse also shows substantial age-related wear and discoloration. There is a notable area of damage along the right edge. The important point is that the primary engraved map image remains substantially intact and readable, and the map remains an attractive and highly decorative example of early European cartography. This is NOT being represented as mint, pristine, or museum condition. The photographs show the actual map being offered and should be considered part of the condition description. SIZE: Approximately 10" x 8", consistent with the dimensions documented in the original 2010 listing. A fascinating piece of early cartographic history and an excellent collectible for anyone interested in Persia/Iran, the Middle East, Central Asia, historical geography, antique maps, or the history of cartography. ORIGINAL ANTIQUE MAP — NOT A MODERN REPRODUCTION.

287625494883.title: Red sunburst D-28 style acoustic guitar flamed mahogany no name
287625494883.desc: This is a a very nice economy guitar, featuring beautiful flamed mahogany sides and back, mahogany neck, rosewood fretboard, spruce top which I imagine is ply. Bound fretboard, marquetry around soundhole and floral pickguard. I have not changed the strings (in fact E is missing) or messed with the neck, I imagine the action could be improved somewhat with a proper setup. It is quite playable as is. Could not find this one anywhere on the internet except a reverse image search found a brand called "Nevada A-197 Foreign" is what the label said on the one I found that looked like this one (evidently very cheap!); although this does not look like a cheap guitar to me, it is a very good starter guitar for someone who wants a guitar with character. Comes in a beat-up hard case that we tried to tape, tape not sticking too good, but at least it keeps the guitar out of trouble.
